Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bright Futures Linen Services provides professional diaper and linen rental and cleaning services to healthcare facilities, daycare centers, and hotels. Our operations focus on high-quality laundering processes, using eco-friendly cleaning agents that comply with all safety and environmental regulations. We emphasize safety through routine maintenance of our industrial machines and employee training programs to minimize injury risks. Our automated systems reduce manual handling, ensuring efficient and hygienic service delivery while maintaining a pristine safety record. We prioritize customer satisfaction by safeguarding client property and ensuring timely and reliable service.
